Method of Attack: SQL Injection vulnerability in the 3CX CRM Integration
Impacted Systems: 3CX CRM Integration with MsSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL databases
Attack Vector: SQL database integrations exposed to internet without Web application firewall
Supply chain attack via Electron-based desktop client
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious tagging by CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, ESET, Palo Alto Networks, SonicWall
